products.name: Ular Envelope Set
products.description: This special stamp issue highlights the diverse wildlife of the country featuring two venomous snakes namely Red-headed Krait Snake (Bungarus flaviceps) - Miniature sheet, Siamese Peninsula Pit Vipers (Trimeresurus sabahi) - RM1.50 and two non-venomous snakes namely Paradise Tree Snake (Chrysopelea paradisi) - RM0.30, Mangrove Snake (Boiga melanota) - RM0.60.
